title: Sign an MSIX package
key_points: App package signing is a required step in the process of creating an MSIX package that can be deployed on Windows.
To successfully install a Windows application, the package doesn't just have to be signed but also trusted on the device.
Azure Artifact Signing (formerly Trusted Signing) is Microsoft's managed code signing service and is recommended for production MSIX signing.
The WinApp CLI provides convenient commands for development signing.
limitations: Not all scenarios are covered by Azure Artifact Signing, some require OV code signing certificates from a CA
Signing with SignTool requires extra setup when using Azure Artifact Signing
asserts: Windows requires MSIX packages to be signed with a valid code signing certificate for deployment.
scope: The document provides guidance on how to sign MSIX app packages for deployment on Windows, including the use of various signing options and tools.
